data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was $13.269m (gross). The report does not quantify a single gross prior-year reserve movement amount for years prior to 2016; it does note a commutation agreement in 2017 on the 2015 year of account between syndicates 6050, 623 and 2623. The gross claims outstanding increased overall to $16.012m at 31 December 2017, but no explicit gross prior-year movement (PYD) figure is provided for the older underwriting years in the available notes.
raw_causal_phrases: Syndicate 6050 entered into a commutation agreement with syndicate 623 and syndicate 2623 during 2017 on the 2015 year of account contract.
The most critical estimate included within the syndicate's financial position is the estimate for losses incurred but not reported.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year-reserve movement (PYD) amount for years prior to 2016 was presented in the 'movement in prior year's provision' format. A commutation of the 2015 year is stated but not quantified. The claims development table in the technical provisions is presented as development percentages and summary totals by underwriting year; it does not provide an explicit gross PYD amount to compute a definitive prior_year_development_gbp_m. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. All monetary values are reported in the syndicate's native currency (USD) and converted to millions.
